form._howTo: Contact form provider. WEB3FORMS (recommended, free, no account): paste the access key from web3forms.com into web3formsKey, set provider to "web3forms", rebuild and push. FORMSPREE (alternative): paste the form ID (the part after formspree.io/f/) into formspreeId and set provider to "formspree". Empty provider = the form opens the visitor's email app (mailto).

Its only download link is on /cv/, saved as downloadName. The CV page itself is linked only from the About dropdown (consultation first, Phase 17). To replace it, redact the new original the same way and keep the file name.
